annotations.description: Bottoming Seafloor Oracle over Bone Pit Brute leaves a hand with no creature plays until turn 6 (Bone Pit Brute at 6 mana). Seafloor Oracle at 4 mana would have been a much earlier play and a stronger card in this deck. The hand kept (Bone Pit Brute, Island, Molten Birth, Mountain, Mountain, Temur Battle Rage) has a very awkward curve with no creatures until turn 6.
annotations.actionTaken: Put Seafloor Oracle on the bottom of the library
annotations.betterLine: Put Bone Pit Brute on the bottom — it's the most expensive card at 6 mana. Keeping Seafloor Oracle gives a 4-mana creature play and a much better curve. Alternatively, Temur Battle Rage could be bottomed as it needs a creature to target and isn't useful without one.

annotations.description: Mulliganed a keepable 6-card hand down to 5. The hand had 3 lands, Molten Birth castable on turn 3, and Bone Pit Brute for turn 6. While the hand lacks early plays and needs a second blue source for Seafloor Oracle, going to 5 cards in Limited is extremely costly and rarely correct when you have adequate lands and playable spells.
annotations.betterLine: Keep the 6-card hand. Three lands with Molten Birth on turn 3 and Bone Pit Brute on turn 6 is a functional Limited hand, even if not ideal.

annotations.description: Thirst for Knowledge offers the option to discard one artifact card instead of two non-artifact cards. The player declined to discard Hedron Archive as the artifact, choosing instead to discard two cards. This loses an entire card's worth of value. Moreover, they have Archaeomender in hand which can retrieve the Hedron Archive from the graveyard later, making the artifact discard essentially free.
annotations.actionTaken: Declined to discard an artifact card, requiring discarding two cards instead of one.
annotations.betterLine: Discard Hedron Archive as the artifact card to only lose one card instead of two. Archaeomender can later retrieve the Hedron Archive from the graveyard, making this line strictly better.

annotations.description: Thirst for Knowledge allows discarding a single artifact card instead of two non-artifact cards. Hedron Archive is an artifact in hand that could have been discarded alone, saving a card. While keeping Hedron Archive to ramp toward Scholar of the Lost Trove (7 mana) is defensible, the player is at only 3 lands and could later use Archaeomender to retrieve the discarded Hedron Archive from the graveyard, making the artifact discard line potentially superior in total card economy.
annotations.actionTaken: Chose to discard Plains (non-artifact) as first of two discards, committing to losing two cards total.
annotations.betterLine: Discard Hedron Archive as the single artifact discard for Thirst for Knowledge, saving a card. Archaeomender in hand can later retrieve Hedron Archive from the graveyard, preserving both card advantage and the ramp plan.

annotations.description: The player is discarding 2 non-artifact cards to Thirst for Knowledge instead of discarding just 1 artifact (Hedron Archive). This wastes an extra card unnecessarily. Hedron Archive could even be recovered later with Archaeomender already in hand.
annotations.actionTaken: Chose to discard 2 non-artifact cards (including Island) instead of discarding a single artifact
annotations.betterLine: Discard Hedron Archive as the single artifact discard for Thirst for Knowledge, saving a card. Archaeomender in hand can later retrieve Hedron Archive from the graveyard if needed.

annotations.description: Opponent is at 8 life with only Distinguished Conjurer 1/2 as a blocker. Casting Crashing Tide to bounce the Conjurer removes all blockers, then attacking with Tectonic Giant (trigger for 3 damage, opponent to 5), Bloodrage Brawler (4), and unblockable Triton Shorestalker (1) deals 3+4+1=8 combat damage for guaranteed lethal. Without bouncing, opponent can block Bloodrage Brawler with Conjurer and survive at 1 life.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority in precombat main without casting Crashing Tide
annotations.betterLine: Cast Crashing Tide targeting Distinguished Conjurer to remove the only blocker, then attack with all three creatures for guaranteed lethal (3 trigger + 8 combat = 11 damage vs 8 life)
